items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: That’s what really made me really decide to be a musician. Trane, and like that.

ctx.x: I really like that answer. I think the reason it came to my mind is I’ve read over the years critics, authors etcetera who listen to some of the music from the sixties when Coltrane and Archie Shepp etcetera were – for lack of a better term – they were playing pretty out. And sometimes you see the comment like, “What are they so angry about?” And I never talked to them but other people say this is not anger, this is something else.

Yeah, see I’m from that. That’s what really made me really decide to be a musician. Trane, and like that. And my dissertation was the jazz avant garde is the most representative art music to come from the United States in the late twentieth century.
